mapper.select: select id, user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time from sys_chat_session order by create_time desc
select id, user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time from sys_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_chat_session (id, user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{sessionName}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_chat_session set session_name = #{sessionName}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
